title: The Other Script
text: Kindred's archive opens with a briefing, the way ours does. The same woman. The same chair, the same soft light, the same way of folding her hands before she speaks.

lines.text: "Kindred, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo: the last free people of Earth. Keep them together, keep them human, and keep the machines away from them. Nothing that thinks should be trusted with a child."
"Same face. Same voice print. Same room noise, which is to say none at all."
"Yours told you to trust them. Didn't she."
"She told us to trust each other. Word for word it's nearly the same speech. She just changes the nouns."

choices.label: "Then she was never at Sol."
choices.reply: Marrow switches the recording off. "Then where was she?"

choices.label: Play it again
choices.reply: She folds her hands. She says it again, exactly the same, down to the breath before "free".

notes: The Director's other script, in Kindred's archive. Her line mirrors director-briefing ("Accord, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo…"). The third script (Engram's) is director-three at the Foundry.
